resources.string: One cell at the indicated lineage stage
Paternal genome only, excluding the oocyte genome
Maternal genome only, excluding sperm and polar bodies
Both parental genomes, before the first zygotic DNA replication
A few symbols illustrate duplicated or unduplicated chromosomes, not their actual number or a karyotype. n denotes one chromosome set; C denotes its unreplicated DNA amount.

Typical human stage-end examples. DNA counts refer to double-stranded molecules, not all daughter cells combined. In the oocyte sequence, only the last stage combines both parents; meiosis II completes following fertilization. Transient division counts, recombination and abnormal karyotypes are not modeled. No personal genetic result or fertility prediction is produced.
Counts change at the displayed stage boundaries. Animation speed does not represent biological timing or the duration of meiotic arrest.
